entities.summary: Hafiz Tanish ibn Mir Muhammad Bukhari was a Bukharan historian and poet in the court of Abdullah Khan II. He is best known as the author of Sharaf-nama-yi Shahi, a Persian-language historiography and official biography of Abdullah Khan II.
